The '''1965–66 Scottish Division One''' was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] by two points over city rivals [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]]. [[Morton F.C.|Morton]] and [[Hamilton Academical F.C.|Hamilton Academical]] finished 17th and 18th respectively and were relegated to the [[1966–67 Scottish Division Two|1966-67 Second Division]]. It was Celtic's first championship since [[1953–54 Scottish Division One|1954]]. Having both finished outside the top four places for the first (and so far only) time, the [[Old Firm]] clubs not only returned to the top of the table but also contested both domestic cup finals, which had not occurred since the introduction of the [[Scottish League Cup]] in 1946.<ref name="very heaven">[https://books.google.com/books?id=blr6AgAAQBAJ&dq=Old+firm+domination&pg=PA9 'Very Heaven'] (page 9); David Ross, 2007; Lulu.com; {{ISBN|9781430317210}}</ref>
